name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It survives color inversion and reduced motion without breaking. The trade-off is slightly less visible focus for users who rely on high contrast, but 7:1 meets WCAG AAA and keeps the ring usable in all modes.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring at 7:1 still fails on monochrome displays where the ring blends into backgrounds, even with inversion. A 3px ring at 4.5:1 keeps the ring visible in all modes without relying on color. Test with grayscale inversion and a monochrome simulator to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It’s the only option that survives monochrome, inversion, and reduced motion without disappearing. The trade-off is slightly lower contrast than 7:1, but 4.5:1 still meets WCAG AA and keeps the ring usable everywhere. Test with grayscale and inversion to confirm visibility.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-6246, worker-3034, worker-6131 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 4.5:1 still risks blending into busy backgrounds on low-contrast monochrome displays—test with a checkerboard pattern, not just solid grayscale. The real alternative is a 3px ring with a 1px outer glow at 3:1, which survives inversion and motion without disappearing, while meeting WCAG AA in all modes.
